originality.rationale: Exact full-Aut equivariant homotopy model, all subgroup fixed loci and integral permutation module are not consequences of the previously stated nonequivariant wedge homotopy. The accessible 2026 primary paper establishes a natural Frattini reduction, but its explicit equivariance theorem is for p-groups. Welker 1995 and Thévenaz 1985 could contain stronger coverage; their full texts were inaccessible and the risk is retained.
residual_risks: Welker 1995 directly treats equivariant solvable subgroup lattices; lack of original full text leaves a plausible stronger implication unresolved.
Thévenaz 1985 original paper unavailable, though the ordinary wedge theorem is accessible through Woodroofe.
Literature coverage cannot establish uniqueness, and an equivalent explicit affine character may exist outside inspected sources.
